record.question: Answer the following on the basis of the passage. Four men are waiting in Delhi airport for a Mumbai flight. Two are doctors and the other two are businessmen. Two speak Gujarati and two speak Tamil. No two of the same profession speak the same language. Two are Muslim and two are Christians. No two of the same religion are of the same profession nor do they speak the same language. The Tamil speaking doctor is a Christian. 1. The Christian-businessman speaks Gujarati. 2. The Gujarati-speaking doctor is a Muslim. Which of the above statements is/are correct conclusion/conclusions?
